es-s0-p.paragraph: Send the form with your address, the fence you want and rough footage if you know it.

es-s1-p.paragraph: Chris checks the line, the grade and where the gates go, and goes over materials with you.

es-s2-h.title: Get your price, then the build

es-s2-p.paragraph: You get a written quote. Once you approve it, your fence goes on the schedule.

es-ld.paragraph: A few details and a rough idea of the footage is all Chris needs to get started.

es-tag.paragraph: Form preview · nothing here is sent or saved

es-msg-f.paragraph: Gates, height, old fence to remove…

es-demo.paragraph: Demo only. This preview doesn't send anything.
